title: lostfront esp aim no recoil
features:
ESP: Boxes, names, distance, skeleton, and health  
Visibility Check: Detects visible targets  
Team Check: Excludes teammates  
Aim Direction: Shows enemy viewing direction  
Looking Alert: Warns when an enemy is aiming at you  
Tracers: Draws lines to targets  
FPV Detection: Detects FPV drones  
Radar: Displays nearby targets  
Aimbot: Smooth targeting within the selected FOV  
Triggerbot: Automatically fires at targets  
Desync: Shifts the character’s position  
No Recoil: Removes camera shake, kickback, and recoil animations
